actions.instruction: Install the official Python 3.14 WinGet package for the current user.
persistent_changes: Installs Python 3.14 for the current user.
The package may persist a current-user PATH entry.
actions.rollback_instruction: Run the displayed WinGet uninstall command.

actions.instruction: Install the official Git for Windows WinGet package for the current user.
persistent_changes: Installs Git for Windows for the current user.
The package may persist a current-user PATH entry.
actions.rollback_instruction: Run the displayed WinGet uninstall command.

actions.instruction: Install Homebrew's current supported Python formula.
persistent_changes: Installs the current Homebrew Python formula in the Homebrew prefix.
actions.rollback_instruction: Run the displayed Homebrew uninstall command if the formula was newly installed only for this recovery.

actions.instruction: Install Git from the Homebrew core formula repository.
persistent_changes: Installs the Homebrew Git formula in the Homebrew prefix.
actions.rollback_instruction: Run the displayed Homebrew uninstall command if the formula was newly installed only for this recovery.

actions.instruction: Refresh APT package metadata and install Ubuntu's Git package.
persistent_changes: Installs the system Git package and its dependencies.
actions.rollback_instruction: Run the displayed APT remove command; review dependencies before confirming any additional removal.

actions.instruction: Refresh APT package metadata and install Debian's Git package.
persistent_changes: Installs the system Git package and its dependencies.
actions.rollback_instruction: Run the displayed APT remove command; review dependencies before confirming any additional removal.

actions.instruction: Use the distribution's official Python guidance and install a supported Python 3.11+ without removing or replacing the system Python; then run the proof command.
persistent_changes: Depends on the distribution release and the user-reviewed installation method.
actions.rollback_instruction: Use the uninstall route for the exact user-selected distribution package; never remove Ubuntu or Debian's required system Python.

actions.instruction: Use Debian's official Python guidance and install a supported Python 3.11+ without removing or replacing the system Python; then run the proof command.
persistent_changes: Depends on the Debian release and the user-reviewed installation method.
actions.rollback_instruction: Use the uninstall route for the exact user-selected Debian package; never remove Debian's required system Python.

actions.instruction: Open the official Codex CLI installation page, choose the platform-appropriate installation method, sign in interactively, and then run the proof command. The assistant does not execute a download pipeline or alter authentication.
persistent_changes: Depends on the user-selected official Codex CLI installation method.
Interactive sign-in may persist authentication managed by Codex.
actions.rollback_instruction: Use the official uninstall route for the exact user-selected installation method; authentication remains user-controlled.
